source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the contrast, stability and personal/impersonal ambiguity of evil.
key_decisions.before: But the Lord is faithful. He will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
key_decisions.after: But the Lord is faithful; he will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But the Lord is faithful, who will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains two ambiguous genitives rather than resolving whose love or endurance.
key_decisions.before: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s endurance.
key_decisions.after: May the Lord direct your hearts into God's love and Christ's endurance.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: May the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God and into the steadfastness of Christ.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps strong authority, communal distance and the conduct standard.
key_decisions.before: We command you, brothers and sisters, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from every brother or sister who lives disorderly and not according to the tradition they received from us.
key_decisions.after: Now we command you, brothers and sisters, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from every brother or sister who lives disorderly and not according to the tradition received from us.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now we command you, brothers and sisters, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you keep away from every brother or sister walking disorderly and not according to the tradition that you received from us.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves unwillingness rather than inability and the quoted command.
key_decisions.before: For even when we were with you, we gave you this command: if anyone is not willing to work, that person should not eat.
key_decisions.after: Even when we were with you, we gave you this command: “If anyone is unwilling to work, that person should not eat.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For even when we were with you, we gave you this command: if anyone is not willing to work, neither let him eat.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves social discipline and its stated corrective aim.
key_decisions.before: If anyone does not obey our word in this letter, take note of that person and do not associate closely with them, so that they may be ashamed.
key_decisions.after: If anyone does not obey our word in this letter, take note of that person and do not associate closely, so that the person may feel ashamed.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And if anyone does not obey what we say in this letter, take note of that person and do not associate with him, so that he may be put to shame.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the limit on discipline and familial identity.
key_decisions.before: Yet do not regard that person as an enemy; warn them as a brother or sister.
key_decisions.after: Yet do not regard that person as an enemy, but warn them as a brother or sister.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Yet do not regard him as an enemy, but warn him as a brother or sister.
